title: Sara people - Wikipedia
text: The Sara (Kameeni) are the largest ethnic group in the Republic of Chad, concentrated in the Moyen-Chari, the Logone Oriental, the Logone Occidental, and parts of the Tandjile regions.

title: Sara languages - Wikipedia
text: The term "Sara languages", sometimes called "Sara Proper languages", is distinct from the so-called "Sara Kaba languages". The latter include Sara Dunjo, Kaba Deme and Kaba Na.

title: Kaba languages - Wikipedia
text: The Kaba languages, also called Sara Kaba but not to be confused with the Sara languages, comprise three to five languages of Chad and the Central African Republic. They are Bongo–Bagirmi languages of the Central Sudanic language family.
